Research Technician I, Molecular Biology Core
Halvorsen Institute for Biomedical Research | Full time, on site
About the role
The Molecular Biology Core supports twelve research groups with nucleic acid extraction, PCR and qPCR, and sample management. You will work under the core manager and alongside two senior technicians.
Responsibilities
• Prepare reagents, buffers, and media following standard operating procedures
• Run PCR, qPCR, and gel electrophoresis on samples submitted by research groups
• Extract DNA and RNA from tissue and cell culture samples
• Keep accurate records in the electronic lab notebook and sample tracking database
• Maintain lab equipment, track inventory, and place supply orders
• Follow biosafety and chemical safety procedures, including proper waste disposal
• Other duties as assigned
Required qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in biology, biochemistry, or a related field, or expected by June 2027
• Hands-on laboratory experience from coursework, research, or employment
• Strong attention to detail and careful record keeping
• Ability to follow written protocols and ask questions when something is unclear
• Comfortable with Excel or Google Sheets
Preferred qualifications
• Experience with qPCR or cell culture
• Undergraduate research experience
• Familiarity with an electronic lab notebook
Salary range: $44,000 to $48,000 per year, plus benefits. The Halvorsen Institute is an equal opportunity employer.
